text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser braced herself, fully 
aware of the formidable rival she was 
bound to clash with on the Triple Crown 
path: Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her friend Nice Nature was 
troubled. When asked, she revealed it was 
due to Tokai Teio missing out on the 
Kikuka Sho, among other things—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distracted by the public chatter 
surrounding it, she seemingly couldn't 
focus on training. "What if Tannhauser 
were in the same position?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To that question, Matikanetannhauser 
answers resolutely: "I just have to win 
with enough momentum to silence all the 
gossip!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her words gave Nice Nature the 
courage to face forward and keep fighting. 
Her bright smile had finally returned.
